brief: Close a budget period by comparing the plan with actual receipts and payments.

title.es-MX: Cierra el periodo con registros reales
title.pt-BR: Feche o período com registros reais

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Close the period with actual records"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Cierra el periodo con registros reales"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Feche o período com registros reais"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Close a budget period by comparing the plan with actual receipts and payments.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Compare what was planned with what actually arrived and was paid.
instruction.misconception: Reporting the forecast as actual results or overlooking missing receipts and payments when closing a period.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Expected income is not a receipt. Close the period using completed movements, then compare them with the original plan.
Closing a period does not pay or erase a bill.
Missing purchases make the actual spending total incomplete.
Actual receipts follow arrival dates rather than expected dates.
Closing compares the forecast with evidence of actual costs.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
